source_excerpt: A wedding that turns into a nightmare, a mysterious masked attacker and a groom forced to relive the same day form the premise of this Malayalam fantasy-comedy. Starring Sajin Gopu and Nikhila Vimal, the film combines a time-loop mystery with elements of comedy and thriller. Its unusual storyline could make it an interesting choice for viewers looking for something different this Halloween.The story follows Kuttan, a 36-year-old man whose wedding day takes an unexpected turn. What should have been a celebration with his bride, Sharmila, soon becomes a frightening experience. As strange incidents begin to unfold, Kuttan realizes that escaping the situation will require more than simply surviving one night.Sajin Gopu plays a groom with a complicated pastDirected by Sudhi Maddison, the film features Sajin Gopu as Kuttan and Nikhila Vimal as Sharmila. Kuttan has a past that makes people around him question his good fortune when he manages to marry someone as young and attractive as Sharmila.However, the attention surrounding his marriage soon gives way to a series of unsettling developments. The wedding takes place on a day marked by unusual occurrences, setting the stage for the strange events that follow. Kuttan initially appears to have found happiness, but his celebrations do not last long.A rare comet and strange omens mark the wedding dayThe couple's wedding coincides with the appearance of a comet that reportedly returns once every 3,000 years. The celestial event adds an unusual backdrop to the celebrations, while several ill omens make the day increasingly disturbing.Despite the strange signs, Kuttan and Sharmila get married. The groom expects to spend his first night with his wife in peace. Instead, a masked assailant attacks him, turning what should have been a memorable occasion into a terrifying ordeal.Kuttan gets trapped in a repeating cycleThe attack becomes the starting point of Kuttan's biggest problem. Every time he is killed or attacked, he finds himself waking up at the beginning of the same day. The wedding preparations and the events surrounding the ceremony begin all over again.As the cycle continues, Kuttan has to make sense of the incidents and understand why he cannot move beyond that particular day. His repeated attempts to escape the situation also bring opportunities for comic moments. However, the mystery surrounding the masked attacker remains central to his struggle.The central question is whether Kuttan can discover what is happening and find a way to stop the cycle. His efforts to protect himself and reach a normal life form the main conflict of the story.Malayalam film brings a Kerala setting to the time-loop conceptTime-loop stories have featured in several Hollywood productions, including 'Happy Death Day' (2017), 'Totally Killer' (2023) and 'Time Cut' (2024). These films use repeating timelines to build suspense, introduce unexpected twists and explore characters caught in unusual circumstances.This Malayalam project brings a similar narrative device into a local setting. By placing the action around a Kerala wedding, it combines familiar social situations with fantasy and thriller elements.Sajin Gopu carries the central storyline as Kuttan, a groom whose wedding celebrations turn into an endless struggle. Nikhila Vimal plays Sharmila, whose marriage to Kuttan becomes part of the unusual chain of events.With Sudhi Maddison directing, the film brings together fantasy, comedy and suspense through its central time-loop premise.
